a.quote: The Standard Reserve went live today, an onchain reserve protocol built around ETH flows, using an OlympusDAO-style design with a hard-capped 1B STANDARD supply.

b.quote: IMD tries to do the opposite: every sell burns its own supply, stakers earn from those burns, and the whole thing is meant to bankroll 2,000 AI agents running on-chain. It's Fren Pet, the old Base tamagotchi, reborn on Ethereum with a self-funding economy bolted on
